correctness.rationale: For each length-four word, collapse its distinct deletion descendants before applying the dual inequality. The 15 equality patterns exhaust the possibilities over any alphabet. An independent exact replay confirms all 15 shadow sums are at most one and the 19 listed words cover all 64 quaternary targets (60 covered once, four twice). The four orbit sizes give q/2 + 7q(q-1)/8 + q(q-1)(q-2)/4; summing over any cover and taking the ceiling gives the stated bound, including q=2,3 where some patterns are absent. At q=4 the total is 37/2, giving 19. The finite replay verifies the patterns and witness; the symbolic count proves the all-alphabet implication.
